subject: general
question: Which of the following is not present in a nucleus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**vacuole**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vacuole**

 
 
• Vacuoles are membrane-bound sacs within the cytoplasm of a **cell**.
 
• They are involved in a variety of functions, including maintaining the shape of the cell, storage of** nutrients or waste products, and the regulation of turgor pressure**.
 
• They are not found inside the **nucleus**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Nucleolus
 This is a small, dense structure within the nucleus. It is the site of ribosome synthesis in cells.
 
 

 Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA)
 DNA is the genetic material that contains the instructions for the development and function of living organisms. It is located within the nucleus of a cell.
 
 

 Genes
 Genes are segments of DNA that act as the fundamental units of heredity. Genes direct the production of proteins and influence an organism's characteristics. They are located on the chromosomes within the nucleus of a cell.
